### Download Hive

I en browser, søg efter "hive download". Naviger frem til den nyeste, find de binære filer. \
Netop nu er version 4.2.1 den seneste.

Download med `wget`
```bash
wget https://dlcdn.apache.org/hive/hive-q.q.q/apache-hive-q.q.q-bin.tar.gz
```

### udpak
```bash
tar xvzf apache-hive-q.q.q-bin.tar.gz -C BigData
```

### Redier hive-miljø i `.bashrc`
```bash
export HIVE_HOME="/home/[user]/BigData/apache-hive-q.q.q-bin"
export PATH=$PATH:$HIVE_HOME/bin
export HADOOP_CONF_DIR=$HADOOP_HOME/etc/Hadoop
```
Bemærk `[user]` er _din_ user, `q.q.q` er den version du har downloaded.
__Husk__: `source .bashrc`

### Kopier hive konfigurationsfil 
```bash
cp BigData/apache-hive-4.2.1-bin/conf/hive-default.xml.template BigData/apache-hive-4.2.1-bin/conf/hive-site.xml
```
`q.q.q` bla bla

### Gør Hive til proxy for hadoop

Rediger `$HadoopHome/etc/Hadoop/core-site.xml`

Tilføj:
```bash
<property>
    <name>hadoop.proxyuser.[user].groups</name>
    <value>*</value>
</property>
<property>
    <name>hadoop.proxyuser.[user].hosts</name>
    <value>*</value>
</property>
<property>
    <name>hadoop.proxyuser.server.hosts</name>
    <value>*</value>
</property>
<property>
    <name>hadoop.proxyuser.server.groups</name>
    <value>*</value>
</property>
```

### Genstart hadoop
```bash
$HADOOP_HOME/sbin/stop-all.sh 
$HADOOP_HOME/sbin/start-all.sh 
```

### Opret mapper og set rettighedder INDE i HDFS
```bash
hdfs dfs -mkdir /tmp
hdfs dfs -mkdir /user
hdfs dfs -mkdir /user/hive
hdfs dfs -mkdir /user/hive/warehouse
```

```bash
hdfs dfs -chmod g+w /tmp
hdfs dfs -chmod g+w /user/hive/warehouse
```

### Opdater hives mappe indstillinger i `hive-site.xml`
Rediger `$HIVE_HOME/conf/hive-site.xml`
Find disse propperties og opdater deres værdier:
```xml
<property>
      <name>hive.metastore.warehouse.dir</name>
      <value>/user/hive/warehouse</value>
</property>
<property>
      <name>hive.downloaded.resources.dir</name>
      <value>/tmp/${user.name}_resources</value>
      <description></description>
</property>
<property>
      <name>hive.exec.local.scratchdir</name>
      <value>/tmp/${user.name}</value>
      <description>Local scratch space for Hive jobs</description>
</property>
```
